item.title: Industrial Accident, Jet Ski Assault, Cowpen Shooting
item.ns0:title: Industrial Accident, Jet Ski Assault, Cowpen Shooting
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, police launch an investigation into a tragic industrial accident in the exclusive Lyford Cay community that claimed the lives of two workers. Investigators are also probing a fatal daytime shooting off Cowpen Road West after a man was ambushed at his own doorstep. Meanwhile, licensed jet ski operators at Goodman's Bay push back against negative fallout following viral assault allegations involving an illegal operator. Plus, the political clash over the National Investment Fund intensifies as the ruling party dismisses opposition attacks, while persistent power outages in Eleuthera force early school dismissals.
